name: v0.9.1
body:
## Install without a Rust toolchain

```sh
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/releases/latest/download/install.sh && sh install.sh
```

`install.sh` picks the Linux x86_64/aarch64 or macOS aarch64 tarball, verifies its SHA-256 against `checksums.txt`, and verifies the Sigstore signature with `cosign` or a GitHub attestation when either is installed. It installs into `$HOME/.local` (or `--prefix`), adds the desktop file and icons on Linux, and writes a receipt so `--uninstall` removes exactly what it installed — never your config, state or vault. It never runs `sudo`. `--require-signature` makes signature verification mandatory.

Windows builds now start from Explorer without a console window, while `muninn --version`, `--help`, `--check` and `--list-links` still print and return 0/1/2 from a terminal.

## Release hardening

The build matrix no longer cancels the remaining platforms when one apt mirror fails, package installs retry with bounded backoff, and a rerun refreshes an existing release instead of failing on it. This release was built and published by that workflow.

## Assets

Nine files: Linux x86_64/aarch64 tarballs, macOS aarch64 tarball, Windows x86_64 zip, the two `.deb` packages, `install.sh`, `checksums.txt` and the Sigstore bundle. The Arch `muninn-bin` recipe is in `packaging/aur/`; publishing it to the AUR is a separate manual step.

## What's Changed
* site: 0.9.0 snapshot and a Locked notes feature section by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/230
* docs(core): retire the stale SAF-02 conflict TODO by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/241
* ci(web): check core and graph on wasm32 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/242
* installer: add install.sh for Linux and macOS (#231) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/244
* installer: add an AUR muninn-bin recipe (#233) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/243
* ci(release): retry apt installs and make release reruns safe (#235) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/245
* fix(windows): hide the GUI console without losing headless output (#232) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/246
* Release 0.9.1: installer, AUR recipe, release resilience, Windows console by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/247
